headline: Bitcoin Stalls Near $65,000 as Futures Carry Trade Yields Dry Up
summary: Bitcoin traded near $65,000 as returns on the popular crypto futures basis carry trade fell to parity with US Treasuries, according to institutional trading platform Talos.
why: The basis trade—holding spot crypto while selling futures contracts—has been a cornerstone of institutional crypto arbitrage. Diminishing yields reduce synthetic institutional liquidity.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Lower arbitrage margins on futures contracts dampen speculative institutional inflows.
